messages:
Anika: quick question — for the SLOs surfaced in console, do we want a per-tenant 'quick snooze' toggle that doesn't change underlying notify policy but only suppresses UI alerts for X minutes? also thinking about tying that to the routing policy so we can route to fallback before snooze expires.
Tom: i like quick snooze but worried about alerting cycles and missed escalations. if we do snooze-only UI, oncall still needs immediate paging unless they opt-out.
Priya: +1. We should expose sampling & backoff params in API. current notify_policy is opaque and makes debugging hard.
Maya: can we add a 'soft_backoff' field that reduces fanout probability instead of muting? helps when capacity is saturated and prevents hard outages.
Liam: example shape to discuss:
```
notify_policy: {
  sampling: { rate: 0.2, window_secs: 300 },
  soft_backoff: { capacity_threshold: 0.8, scale_down: 0.5 }
}
```
Anika: nice. UX question: console needs a compact toggle and a 'why suppressed' tooltip that links to telemetry showing sampling decisions and capacity signals.
Tom: telemetry: expose per-decision reason codes (sampled, quiet_window, tenant_snooze, capacity_backoff) so ops can debug without guessing.
ops-oncall: +1 on reason codes. also need a one-off 'force-unmute' that bypasses sampling for a single escalation.
devops-bot: deploy queued: feature/notify-policy-api -> staging in 4m
Priya: api contract preference: enumerated decision codes rather than free text. also add a fallback behavior: if sampling metadata missing, assume notify so we don't accidentally mute everyone.
Maya: rollout plan suggestion: enable sampling off by default, gate behind per-tenant feature flag; collect two weeks of telemetry with reason codes before flipping for larger tenants.
Liam: question: do we persist sampling decisions in DB for replay, or just emit events to telemetry? storing in telemetry (events) is cheaper but harder to query for bulk audits.
Tom: agree. if we go event-only, update event schema to include tenant_id, route_id, decision_code, model_version, token_count. also schedule privacy review for tenant_id surfacing.
Anika: i'll draft UX copy for 'quick snooze' and the tooltip. Priya, can you PR the API shape? we'll iterate on naming and the feature flag UX.
Priya: on it — I'll push a draft PR to #pr-reviews by EOD and include schema and example fixtures.
Maya: when PR's ready ping me for rollout checklist and the staging test plan (capacity-sim).
Anika: thanks all :thumbsup:
